title: Dogfood Record (Persisted)
description: Canonical persisted record written by the central verifier. Includes all source-authored fields plus verifier-owned fields. Stored in records/ (accepted) or records/_rejected/ (rejected). Never authored by source repos.

schema_version.description: Semver of the persisted record schema.

policy_version.description: Semver of the policy this record was evaluated against. Set by verifier.

run_id.description: Unique dogfood run identifier. Carried from submission. Charset is constrained because run_id becomes a filesystem path segment in the persisted record path; this mirrors the persist-time guard.

provider.description: SCM provider that ran the workflow. 'github' (GitHub Actions) or 'gitlab' (GitLab CI). Carried verbatim from the submission.

workflow.description: Workflow filename that produced the submission (e.g. a GitHub Actions workflow YAML or '.gitlab-ci.yml').

provider_run_id.description: Provider-native run identifier. For 'github' this is the GitHub Actions run ID; for 'gitlab' this is the GitLab pipeline ID (or job ID when run_url points at a job).

actor.description: GitHub username that triggered the workflow.

ci_checks.description: Machine-evaluated CI results. Optional — not all dogfood runs include CI.

scenario_results.description: Dogfood evidence. At least one scenario required.

scenario_id.description: Stable ID matching a scenario definition in the source repo.

attested_by.description: Human attester ID. Verifier enforces presence when execution_mode is human or mixed.

blocking_reason.description: Required when verdict is blocked. Verifier enforces.

step_results.description: Per-step execution results. Bridges scenario steps to record evidence.

step_id.description: Must match a step.id from the scenario definition.

expires_at.description: When this evidence URL will become unavailable.

overall_verdict.description: Source proposes, verifier confirms or downgrades. Verifier never upgrades.

proposed.description: Verdict as proposed by the source repo.

downgraded.description: True if verifier downgraded the proposed verdict.

verification.description: Set by the central verifier. Never authored by source.

status.description: Final verification outcome. No pending state in persisted records.

provenance_confirmed.description: True if the provider API (GitHub Actions or GitLab CI, selected by source.provider) confirmed the source run exists and matches the claimed repo, commit, and finished state.

schema_valid.description: True if submission passed JSON Schema validation.

policy_valid.description: True if record satisfies all applicable policy rules.

rejection_reasons.description: Machine-readable reasons for rejection. Empty if accepted.

integrity.title: Integrity Chain Entry
integrity.description: Tamper-evident hash-chain metadata stamped by the persist layer when this record is written. Optional and backward-compatible: records persisted before the integrity chain existed have no integrity block and remain valid. The digest is computed over the record WITH this block removed (you cannot hash the digest into itself), so it is stable regardless of the integrity block's contents.

submission_digest.title: Submission Digest
submission_digest.description: Lowercase sha256 hex (64 chars) of the canonicalized record with the integrity block removed. Recomputed by the chain verifier to detect tampering.

prev_digest.title: Previous Digest
prev_digest.description: The submission_digest of the previous record in the append-only chain, or 64 zeros (the genesis digest) for the first entry. Links this record to its predecessor.

seq.title: Chain Sequence Number
seq.description: Monotonic position of this record in the append-only chain, starting at 0 for the genesis entry.
